frameworks.name: Completion with Integrity
frameworks.core_mechanism: Defining exit criteria upfront and enforcing pre-agreed handoff constraints
frameworks.definition: A framework for strategic initiatives that prioritizes clarity and surveillance over control.
frameworks.application: Protecting cognitive bandwidth and ensuring quality control in complex systems.

frameworks.name: Table and Shoulder Test
frameworks.core_mechanism: Isolating two distinct variables: neurological load versus operational drift
frameworks.definition: The reality is that top performers don't decay overnight without structural friction.
frameworks.application: Before scheduling an uncomfortable confrontation, run the Table and Shoulder Test.

frameworks.name: Operational Velocity vs. Scope
frameworks.core_mechanism: Has the company's operational velocity outpaced the scope of the seat he was hired into?
frameworks.definition: Sit across from him as an architect, not an interrogator.
frameworks.application: Primary diagnostic question: 'Where is the internal system fighting you right now?'

frameworks.name: Regulating One's Own State
frameworks.core_mechanism: Regulating one's own state first, giving them the safety to acknowledge reality.
frameworks.definition: Run the diagnosis tomorrow and report back.
frameworks.application: When you regulate your own state first, you give them the safety to acknowledge reality.
